C1093.title: Shanghai Police Crack Down on Malware-Enabled 'Screen Hijacking' Ad Fraud Case
C1093.summary: Shanghai police uncovered a case of illegal control over computer information systems, where suspects used malware to force full-screen advertisements for profit—a typical example of ad fraud leveraging malicious techniques.

references.title: Malware 'hijacks' screens to play ads for profit, Shanghai police crack case of illegal control of mobile phone systems...
